title: Noob asking for Pro Tips
author: don-ramon-89
selftext:
Hi everyone, :rose:

I have no background in drawing, game art or animation. Writing has always been my creative outlet, and over the years I’ve created characters that mean a lot to me. I’d love to see them exist somewhere beyond my notebooks and my imagination.

I previously paid a game developer from my town to help with this. It dragged on for around two years, and I never received a single animation. I felt taken advantage of financially, and the experience left me feeling depressed and really discouraged about the whole project.

I’m now trying to find the confidence to have a go myself, even if that means starting with something very small.

For those of you with experience in game art or animation, where would you suggest I begin? Are there any beginner-friendly AI tools or workflows that could help me create sprites, assets and simple animations of my characters?

I’m willing to learn, practise and take my time. I just don’t really know what a sensible first step looks like. Even a small bit of guidance from someone experienced would mean a lot.
